native_checks.generic_sum_precision: CUDA plus<float> accumulator with double result; output must equal its FP32 cast widened back to double, or be NaN.
native_checks.optional_sum_precision: Transparent plus with double init; scalar/empty optional weights retain source host multiplication.
native_checks.median_tolerance: Exact FP32 bits or both NaNs.
native_checks.reduction_tolerance: Modes other than 2 require numerical equality or both NaNs. Wide-exponent mode uses the original reference bounds below.
native_checks.generic_bound: steps * 2^-23 / (1 - steps * 2^-23) * sum_abs, with eight steps for each ceil(n/256) level.
native_checks.compensated_reference: Generic sums additionally checked against the existing compensated reference in modes 0 through 3.
native_checks.precision_extension: Comparator additionally requires exact 2*double(FLT_MAX) for optional-weight overflow witness; original native test asserts finite. All original native checks remain unchanged.

cuda_consumer.weights: Array weights explicitly resident on CUDA via public tensor/vector APIs and MakeOptionalWeights.
cuda_consumer.native_tensor_output_residency: For nonempty matrix cases, require CUDA device and no host-readable output before capture.
cuda_consumer.host_boundaries: Empty generic sums and scalar optional weights retain source host behavior; scalar-return reductions publish on host.
cuda_consumer.expected_errors: Weighted-mean expected rejections must contain the source zero-total-weight message; unrelated exceptions fail.
cuda_consumer.input_policy: Input-only files have no CPU references, compensated references, magnitudes, or expected GPU results.
cuda_consumer.gpu_requirement: Actual NVIDIA GPU required; no skipped pass or CPU fallback.

comparison.policy: Check each GPU independently against recorded CPU/reference values using the original policies; always retain GPU-to-GPU bit differences.
comparison.not_a_pairwise_relaxation: Bounds are not doubled or widened to accommodate different reduction associations.
comparison.reference_storage: Metal records carry 515 reference words and two oracle words per case; compensated/magnitude values are meaningful for the 63 reduction cases and zero elsewhere.

exit_codes.0: Identical recorded GPU outputs that also satisfy reference checks
exit_codes.1: Invalid evidence or failed reference/precision checks
